correctness.rationale: The graph and robustness threshold are explicitly defined. Exact independent-set recurrence and a second four-subset definition agree over all 65536 vertex masks. The deterministic matching has 2364 disjoint cover pairs in the 4812-face augmented poset, 84 critical dimension-five faces, and a complete directed Hasse graph with 22008 incidences; a topological sort consumes all 4812 vertices. Removing the empty-face pair produces one critical 0-cell and 84 critical 5-cells, so Forman discrete Morse theory proves a wedge of 84 five-spheres. Independent mod-two ranks [0,15,105,455,960,828,0] corroborate the integral conclusion. Limits: finite exhaustive proof for one graph, not an infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The specified 4x4 grid is the first natural equal-sided width-four instance beyond the published rectangular-grid k<=3 theorem and not in the proved all-k edge-gluing subclass. A complete exact k=4 homotopy classification tests a central finite case of the explicit 2026 higher-robustness conjecture. The 84 top-dimensional spheres agree with the predicted binomial at nine elementary squares, while the full acyclic certificate distinguishes homotopy classification from a numerical Euler check. No arbitrary grid or k extension is claimed.
